assertions.name: fleet_prerequisites
assertions.expected: SSH for every node + a data volume for the injection target

assertions.name: s1_kill_succeeded
assertions.expected: node 1 SIGKILLed and restarted

assertions.name: s1_write_completed_with_node_down
assertions.expected: PUT acked 2xx while the victim is down (quorum from survivors)

assertions.name: s1_membership_converged_after_restart
assertions.expected: all 3 nodes Alive after the victim rejoins

assertions.name: s1_object_readable_from_restarted_node
assertions.expected: the blob is served with correct bytes from the restarted node

assertions.name: s1_object_readable_from_survivor
assertions.expected: the blob is served with correct bytes from a survivor

assertions.name: s1_hints_reconverged
assertions.expected: hint debt is fully delivered after the victim rejoins

assertions.name: s2_latency_injected
assertions.expected: +500ms netem on enp7s0 (node 1)

assertions.name: s2_injection_observable_on_wire
assertions.expected: RTT increases while netem is applied (functional injection check, not a latency bound)

assertions.name: s2_cluster_served_correct_bytes_during_latency
assertions.expected: every write is readable from its writer with correct bytes; the first key replicates to every node
assertions.actual: writes_ok=7 ok_reads=7 read_misses=0 wrong_bytes=0 per_node=[1, 1, 1] writes=10 membership_views=30

assertions.name: s2_membership_timeline_recorded
assertions.expected: the membership timeline is recorded as evidence (suspicion is not a failure)
assertions.actual: 30 per-node views recorded during the injection

assertions.name: s2_latency_removed
assertions.expected: the netem qdisc is removed

assertions.name: s2_membership_recovers_after_removal
assertions.expected: all 3 nodes Alive after latency removal

assertions.name: s2_no_data_loss_after_removal
assertions.expected: a key written under latency is served correctly after removal

assertions.name: s3_data_mount_usable
assertions.expected: /mnt/oceanfs-data is a usable mountpoint on node 1

assertions.name: s3_baseline_replicated
assertions.expected: every baseline key is served from every node before the fill

assertions.name: s3_data_volume_filled
assertions.expected: /mnt/oceanfs-data filled to 95% on node 1

assertions.name: s3_node_survived_fill
assertions.expected: /admin/health keeps answering during the fill

assertions.name: s3_writes_graceful
assertions.expected: every write to the full node produced an HTTP status (no panic/reset)

assertions.name: s3_reads_served_correct_bytes_during_fill
assertions.expected: every baseline read is correct on every node during the fill

assertions.name: s3_rss_and_gc_observed_evidence
assertions.expected: RSS/GC recorded as data — no absolute threshold is asserted

assertions.name: s3_fill_removed
assertions.expected: the fill file is removed and synced

assertions.name: s3_pool_recovered_after_fill_removal
assertions.expected: no pool remains Dead after cleanup

assertions.name: s3_recovery_write_after_fill_removal
assertions.expected: the node accepts writes again after cleanup

assertions.name: s4_blob_written
assertions.expected: a known blob is written with RF >= 2

assertions.name: s4_replicated_to_target
assertions.expected: the victim holds a replica before corruption
assertions.actual: timed out after 60s: HTTP 404 Not Found

assertions.name: background_load_served
assertions.expected: the background workload served at least one operation

assertions.name: hints_settled_at_end
assertions.expected: no hint debt remains at the end of the run

assertions.name: cluster_healthy_at_end
assertions.expected: every node answers /admin/health at the end of the run

assertions.name: no_node_panics
assertions.expected: zero 'panicked' lines in node journald

assertions.name: manifest_integrity
assertions.expected: every written key is readable with a recorded version from >= 1 node
assertions.actual: 1 of 102 keys absent from every node after 381s settle

assertions.name: manifest_read_quorum
assertions.expected: every sampled key is served from >= 2 nodes

assertions.name: durability_counters_observed_evidence
assertions.expected: durability/repair counters recorded as evidence — never threshold assertions

assertions.name: injection_type_vm_kill_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'vm_kill' record

assertions.name: injection_type_latency_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'latency' record

assertions.name: injection_type_latency_remove_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'latency_remove' record

assertions.name: injection_type_disk_fill_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'disk_fill' record

assertions.name: injection_type_disk_fill_remove_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'disk_fill_remove' record

assertions.name: injection_type_segment_corrupt_recorded
assertions.expected: at least one 'segment_corrupt' record

assertions.name: all_injections_succeeded
assertions.expected: every non-skipped injection attempt reports success

assertions.name: platform_skips_recorded
assertions.expected: fleet mode executes every injector (zero skips)

assertions.name: records_attributed_to_injection_node
assertions.expected: all records attributed to node 1

assertions.name: perf_assertions_none
assertions.expected: no throughput/latency threshold is asserted anywhere (correctness only)
assertions.actual: perf: [] — RTT/RSS/GC observations are recorded as data; volume-backed numbers are not comparable to local-disk runs
